8 اشتهر It was, or became, apparent, conspicuous, manifest, notorious, notable, commonly known, or public: (S:) or [it generally means] it was, or became, apparent, &c., as bad, evil, abominable, foul, or unseemly; it was, or became, exposed as such, or rendered notorious in a bad sense or infamous. (A, K.) It (a story, or discourse,) became divulged, or public. (Msb.) اشتهر بِكَذَا: see 1. ＝
-A2- As a trans. verb: see 1 in three places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
